title: Story Professor of Law
bio: Richard H. Fallon, Jr., joined the Harvard Law School faculty as an assistant professor in 1982, was promoted to full professor in 1987, and later served as the Story Professor of Law and an Affiliate Professor in the Government Department. Fallon was a graduate of Yale University (History, 1975) and Yale Law School (1980). He […]
